messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-9821 — high error rate on hosted/text-gen in us-west-2. Trigger: 5xx spike > 10% over 2m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-9821 created and paging schedule: primary=elena, secondary=sam, manager=tara. Phone/phone-call escalation enabled.

elena: on it, pulling up the observability dashboard now. any customer hit list?

josh: support FYI — some customers reported timeouts in the last 3m, creating support ticket list.

mike: 5xx are coming from the runtime pool rdx-gen-03, looks like OOM-ish rejections in the logs.

elena: seeing same, CPU fine, memory spikes then workers restarting. attaching quick logs:```
2026-03-14T16:17:42Z rdx-gen-03 kernel: OutOfMemory: process llm_worker killed
2026-03-14T16:18:01Z rdx-gen-03 runtime: kv-cache allocation failed: cannot allocate 4.0GiB
2026-03-14T16:18:04Z rdx-gen-03 llm_worker[pid=2431]: exiting with code 137
```

sam: if it's kv-cache allocation we might be hitting too-large context or a bad quant profile. can we temporarily reduce token limits for that pool?

elena: good call. applying limit patch to route policy for rdx-gen-03 to max_context=2048 and rate limit longer timeouts. patch command:```
/ops apply routing --pool rdx-gen-03 --set max_context=2048 --set token_timeout_ms=4000
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Routing patch applied to rdx-gen-03 by elena. New traffic policy active.

mike: rolling restart of rdx-gen-03 workers to clear hung allocs. doing controlled 1 node at a time.

elena: acked PD page PD-INC-9821. taking lead until handoff.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note — PD-INC-9821 acknowledged by elena at 2026-03-14T16:19:12Z. Automatic escalation timer paused.

josh: initial customer impact: ~3% of hosted traffic saw 5xx between 16:17-16:20. most cleared; two enterprise customers reported degraded generation latency/timeout.

mike: restart step 1/5 success. memory profiles look more stable on node-1.

sam: on standby as secondary. if ack not renewed by elena in 8m PD will escalate to me (phone).

(elapsed ~7m)

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation firing: secondary (sam) not paged yet because ack active. (automated note)

(ack timeout misconfig)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty escalation policy dispatched: missed-ack timer did not restart due to a stale heartbeat — escalating to secondary (sam) now. Phone call initiated.

sam: missed the first call (was in a meeting), calling in now. dialing -> connected.

sam: on call. elena, status?

elena: restarting remaining nodes, 3/5 done. errors rate down to 2.1% now. I still see one node showing repeated kv-cache allocation failures, isolating it.

sam: recommend draining rdx-gen-03-5 and remove from rotation until we diagnose kernel oom. runbook step: drain -> reprovision -> validate.

mike: draining node-5 now:```
/ops drain-node rdx-gen-03-5 --timeout 120s && /infra reprovision rdx-gen-03-5 --image v2.4.1
```

incident-bot: Node rdx-gen-03-5 removed from rotation by mike.

josh: adding customer comms note: "We're investigating elevated errors for text-gen in us-west-2; mitigation in progress; no data exposure. We'll follow up with ETA."

tara: manager escalation policy watch — if PD escalates to manager because of missed ack or >15m customer impact I'll join the bridge. standing by.

(elapsed ~6m)

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty escalation triggered: manager contact (tara) via phone because incident exceeded 10m unack window due to earlier missed-ack.

tara: joining bridge. pls DM bridge link.

elena: bridge: https://call.redwood/bridge/PD-9821. joining. status: errors falling to <1% after draining faulty node and routing change.

sam: confirming mitigation: route policy limit + node drain reduced tail-allocs. continuing to monitor for 30m.

mike: reprovision finished; node-5 reprovisioned with kernel mitigations and new alloc limits. starting warm-up.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD-INC-9821 mitigation actions recorded: routing-limit applied, drain + reprovision node-5, restart workers.

josh: support update sent to affected customers at 16:37 PT. included temporary workaround (retry with backoff) and reminder of no data exposure.

elena: handing off on-call to sam at 16:40 PT (end of my shift). sam will be primary for the next 8 hours.

sam: taking over. I have full context. monitoring alarms: latency/5xx thresholds set tighter for the pool for next 2h.

tara: internal postmortem and PD playbook: please capture that the missed-ack happened because our PD heartbeat ignored an ack update during a transient API rate limiter hiccup. we'll add a short grace period to prevent immediate manager escalations for similar infrequent false timeouts.

mike: opening infra ticket to add extra observability for kernel oom patterns and to review quantization profiles that increased memory pressure.

sam: last check: error-rate steady at 0.3% over 5m, CPU/mem stable. marking incident as mitigated but will keep the PD incident open until postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-9821 status changed to "mitigated" by sam at 2026-03-14T16:52:00Z. escalation timers stopped.

josh: creating support follow-up to notify customers that root cause investigation is ongoing and we'll provide timeline by EOD.

incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem ticket and link PD incident. Suggested labels: "pagerduty-escalation", "missed-ack", "oom-kernel".

sam: will file postmortem, assign to mike for infra investigation and elena for runtime changes. ETA draft by 2026-03-15 12:00 PT.

tara: thanks team — good coordination. we'll analyze PD policy to reduce noisy manager escalations.

(elapsed ~20m)

sam: final note before I close thread: if anyone sees recurrence please reopen PD and ping #incidents directly.

incident-bot: Thread archived.
